name: 全國姓名統計 — 姓氏排名 (內政部, Ministry of the Interior, Taiwan)
copyright: 內政部 (Ministry of the Interior), Taiwan
note: 2,731 surnames ranked by the number of people holding them, broken down by age
bracket. 陳 is held by 2.6 million. 441 clear Decoy's threshold, which is the whole
truth rather than a truncation -- Chinese surnames are a closed set of a few hundred
Open Government Data License, Taiwan, version 1.0. data.gov.tw states it `is compatible
with the Creative Commons Attribution License 4.0 International` and permits commercial
use and sublicensing. Carried as `LicenseRef-` because it has no SPDX identifier.
Surnames only. Taiwan publishes given-name statistics as a 376-page PDF whose fonts
carry no usable ToUnicode mapping, so it extracts as mojibake and is not machine-
readable by any means short of OCR.
